rules: Never count a blocked, unavailable or not-run cell as a negative brand result.
Keep branded and unbranded queries separate.
Count each brand/domain at most once per answer.
Resolve source URLs and distinguish similarly named companies before counting.
Store raw answers and timestamps; remove account identifiers and unrelated UI/session data.
Report repeat variation, sample size, actual mode and access limitations.
Do not bypass CAPTCHA or authentication, and do not use a generic web-search tool as a substitute for a named AI product.
The protocol is not a visibility result; no growth, ranking or citation claims until observations are collected.
